Title: [LSJ] query: Burn blood effects on some cards

Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
OK this came up in a game just finished.

An empty justicar (sheldon) used a 2nd tradition to untap and block.
Is this possible? As far as I can go over this he could as empty
vampires ignore all burn blood effects. However if this were so then
this would also imply that an empty vampire with sup. FOR could use
the SUP effect of Rolling with the Punches.

Could it be possible that there should be a distiction in the ruling?
Forced Awakening can be used by an empty vamp and an empty vampire can
block Donall O'Connell, but an empty Prince cannot use the 2nd
tradition. I dunno.

Basically, is the burn blood on the second tradition and rolling with
the punches a cost that must be payed or is it by all means a regular
burn blood effect, like FA?

Thankz,

Tim Eijpe

Messages.Author: Frederick Scott
Messages.Body:
Tim Eijpe wrote:
>
> OK this came up in a game just finished.
>
> An empty justicar (sheldon) used a 2nd tradition to untap and block.
> Is this possible? As far as I can go over this he could as empty
> vampires ignore all burn blood effects. However if this were so then
> this would also imply that an empty vampire with sup. FOR could use
> the SUP effect of Rolling with the Punches.

Right. Empty vampires can ignore burn blood _effects_. However, they
don't get freebies when it comes time to pay burn blood _costs_. "Burn
a blood to untap and attempt to block..." is clearly a cost.

...

> Basically, is the burn blood on the second tradition and rolling with
> the punches a cost that must be payed or is it by all means a regular
> burn blood effect, like FA?

A cost that must be paid.

Fred

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>> Basically, is the burn blood on the second tradition and rolling with

>> burn blood effect, like FA?

Yes. Also note that due to different wording, an empty vampire may attempt to
block Donal O'Connor but that same empty vampire cannot attempt to block Giotto
Verducci.

Halcyan 2
